Coordinates daily operational activities to ensure facilities are safe, clean, functional, and prepared for scheduled events and public use;

Coordinates and performs setup and breakdown of tables, chairs, stages, portable walls, and equipment for the Civic Center, Dudley School Community Center, and functions at other City locations, and ensures facilities/sites are prepared according to event requirements;

Monitors facility operations during scheduled events at the Civic Center and Dudley School Community Center and serves as the primary on-site facility representative for operational issues, patron assistance, and coordination with staff, vendors, and contractors;

Responsible for opening, securing, inspecting, and maintaining readiness of City facilities and identifying maintenance and safety concerns;
Maintains and updates facility marquees and signage in support of public information and scheduled events;
Responsible for operation and basic troubleshooting of facility lighting, sound, and audiovisual systems in support of events and programs;

Maintains grounds surrounding the Civic Center and Dudley School Community Center facilities and ensures exterior areas are presentable, safe, and free from hazards. Duties include weed control, trimming vegetation, litter removal, use of hand tools and light equipment, and application of non-restricted pesticides as necessary;
Promptly reports hazards, malfunctions, damages to the interior or exterior of the assigned facility, and any safety concerns to the supervisor;
Maintains maintenance records, operational logs, and setup documentation;
May answer telephones, relay messages, and assist with general office functions as required;
Operates City vehicles and safely uses maintenance tools, lifts, ladders, and light equipment in accordance with established safety procedures;

Contributes to a high-quality work culture through participation in training and mentoring to develop skills, including safety-related training and skills;
Interacts professionally and provides excellent customer service to all levels of City staff and citizens to ensure high operational and service standards; and
Performs duties in accordance with the Employee Manual, Department Policies and Procedures, City of Alamogordo Ordinances, and any applicable State or Federal authority.
Must obtain and maintain required license(s) and/or certification(s);
Duties may be performed at odd and irregular hours, including mornings, evenings, nights, weekends, holidays, and split shifts any day of the week;
Maintains the confidentiality of information obtained during the performance of duties; and
Performs such other duties as may be assigned.
